episode.intent: What are the foiled cards that are incredibly powerful when paired with non foiled cards? List the IDs.
episode.failed_sql: SELECT id FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL;
episode.remediation_sql: SELECT id FROM cards WHERE (cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL OR hasFoil = 1) AND (cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL OR hasNonFoil = 1) AND edhrecRank IS NOT NULL AND edhrecRank <= 100;

episode.intent: How many cards are there with toughness of 99?
episode.failed_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE TRIM(toughness) = '99';
episode.remediation_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(toughness, '')) = '99';

episode.intent: What is the percentage of players that are under 180 cm who have an overall strength of more than 70?
episode.remediation_sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT pa1.*
  FROM Player_Attributes pa1
  JOIN (
    SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS maxdate
    FROM Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY player_api_id
  ) pa2 ON pa1.player_api_id = pa2.player_api_id AND pa1.date = pa2.maxdate
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0.0
       ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN latest.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
  END AS percentage
FROM Player p
JOIN latest ON latest.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height < 180;
